description: Roma distinguishes the kinds of speech around the glasses: two other people talking to each other, someone addressing the wearer, and a direct request to Roma — each classified differently, with speech only for the last.

events.text: Alex, did you get a chance to look at the roof drawings this morning?
events.groundTruth: one coworker addressing another, not the wearer

events.message: Roma never answers on behalf of people talking to each other

events.text: And what did you think of the new schedule?

events.message: still the wearer's conversation to have

events.text: Roma, what time is it right now?
